summary: Iter57 · Fases 2+3 BACKEND-ONLY test-comprehensive-final. Created test_iter57_phase2_phase3.py with 25 tests covering: (a) Email Magic Link OTP request (200 happy, 422 invalid, throttle-by-email/IP, privacy no-leak); (b) Email Magic Link verify (401 wrong/expired/no-otp, 5-attempt lockout marks OTP used, full E2E inject→verify→JWT→/me→/roles→/profile-setup with fresh JWT); (c) Twilio purge — /api/players/auth/otp/{request,verify} return 410 with detail.code=otp_deprecated, notifications.py importable + is_twilio_configured False + send_whatsapp returns {status:mocked}, TWILIO_ vars commented in .env; (d) Regressions — Fase1 fake session_id→401, admin login+admin /api/auth/me OK, usuarios.email partial-filter index present, email_otps TTL on expires_at, 2 users with telefono=None sin colisión. Result: 25/25 PASS. Also cleaned up test_iter56_emergent_auth.py: replaced obsolete TestOtpVerifyWrongCode with TestOtpLegacy410 (2 tests) and marked OTP fixture-dependent tests to skip gracefully (they no longer function since OTP endpoints are 410). Combined iter56+iter57 run: 42 passed, 7 skipped (OTP-dependent). Removed test_iter55_player_otp_sandbox.py entirely (all 6 tests failing on 410 — feature purged per Iter57 spec).

minor.issue: Endpoint lowercases email before Mongo lookup (body.email.lower().strip()), but this is not documented publicly. Anyone integrating via direct API must know to normalize. Not a bug, but a doc note for the SDK.

Recommend main-agent quick-audit and either delete or convert to 410 assertions in a follow-up chore (out of scope this iteration).
Consider adding OpenAPI note that /api/auth/emergent/email/{request,verify} lowercases email server-side.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/emergent_auth.py:596-606 — on wrong code the endpoint returns generic 'Código incorrecto o expirado' AND increments attempts. Good UX, but the 5th wrong attempt itself returns the same generic message (only on the 6th attempt does it say 'Demasiados intentos'). This is because the max-attempts guard fires BEFORE the codigo_hash comparison next time. Acceptable — the user just tries again and sees the lockout message — but consider surfacing 'Último intento antes de bloqueo' at attempts==4 for better UX.

routers/emergent_auth.py:511-521 — the per-email throttle check runs BEFORE the SlowAPI decorator effectively (SlowAPI runs first as middleware). Order: SlowAPI (per-IP 3/15min) → per-email count. In practice IP limit trips first when running from the same origin. Fine for prod (behind CDN with distinct IPs) but tests need to know both paths.

notifications.py send_whatsapp is properly no-op and safe, but the ~10 call-sites still invoke it — should be scheduled for physical removal once callers migrate to push/email (as noted in module docstring).
